accuracy.method: Micro-average: summed edits / summed reference characters. Compact CER removes whitespace. Index52 normalizes decorative leaders and is separate.
accuracy.limitation: Purposive single-run crops; unblinded assistant source references, not independent human gold or whole-issue accuracy. No post-correction error-rate or executable-code claim.

paired_raw_timing.scope: Matched crop calls, excluding startup, rendering, preparation and correction. Missing either timer excludes both engines from the pair.

local_primary.scope: Primary batch responses, including failed and superseded attempts; copied completion IDs counted once. Alternate-engine evaluation excluded. Uncaptured interrupted generation is unknown, so aggregate is a lower bound.

alternate_evaluation.scope: Separately captured alternate Qwen calls; not part of primary restoration tokens.

raw_timing.scope: Worker timers include startup/rendering/validation/export; recognition is nested. Bounds include recovery uncertainty. Batch24 competing-model contamination excluded from clean timing. Raw and work windows overlap; never add these totals.

paid_work.limitation: Response-completion timestamps allocate whole responses to nonoverlapping work windows. Elapsed windows include tool waits, transcription and helper work; source reading also occurs in preparation. No-observation windows are unknown, not free. Reasoning is a subset of output. Span and gaps include idle time. Not a bill, or a causal engine comparison; June paid usage and human review time are unknown.

restoration_cutoff_snapshot.scope: Frozen restoration cutoff before consolidation and reading-room delivery; decision document quotes this scope.

decision: Continue provisional content routing, source correction and human review. Favor Qwen for dense Korean, code and structured content; retain cheap Tesseract probes for simple text and judge observed failures. Raw accuracy advantage is supported; reduced paid correction cost is not causally established.
